name: Remotion-to-HyperFrames Migration
summary: Port an explicitly requested Remotion React composition to HyperFrames and flag patterns that do not translate cleanly.
problem: Framework migration can silently lose interactive or time-dependent behavior when source constructs are translated without checking their rendering semantics.
coreOutcomes: Lint the Remotion source for unsupported patterns
Translate supported composition, timing and media APIs
Evaluate the rendered result against the supplied source composition
requirements: A HyperFrames project and the migration scripts and fixtures
boundaries: One-way migration from Remotion to HyperFrames only
Do not use for fresh composition authoring or reverse export
Stop and report patterns the migration cannot safely preserve
